description: Wasserwerke im Landkreis Vorpommern-Rügen (WFS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodienste.lk-vr.de. The service contains the locations of the waterworks in the Vorpommern-Rügen district based on ALKIS building data. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Waterworks in the district of Vorpommern-Rügen (WFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Wasserwerke, Landkreis Vorpommern-Rügen, inspireidentifiziert. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2025-11-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
